description: Price bars (open, high, low, close, volume), monthly to one-minute, for US stocks and ETFs, stocks listed abroad (SAP.DE, 7203.T), currency pairs (EUR/USD), futures (crude oil, gold), indices and yields (S&P 500, VIX, 10 year yield) and crypto (bitcoin), by symbol or plain name. Stocks adjust for splits and dividends by default (adjustment: none is as traded), with dividends, splits and the total return; returns: true adds daily returns. No key needed; uses the user's Alpaca or Tiingo key for US stocks when set.

adjusted.description: Split- and dividend-adjusted; default true. false is adjustment: none, prices as traded.

adjustment.description: all: adjusted for splits and dividends (the default); splits: for splits only, so prices compare across a split and leave dividends out; none: as traded each day, the price a trade or a filing of that date shows.

interval.description: Bar size; default 1Day. Minute bars go back 30 days at 1Min and 60 days at 5 to 30 minutes on the keyless source (default: the last 5 days); Tiingo is daily only.

returns.description: Also return simple returns from close to close (returns[i] is from dates[i] to dates[i+1]), ready for beta, correlation or Sharpe tools.

start.description: First date; default one year ago.

symbol.description: A ticker (AAPL, BRK.B), a stock listed abroad with its market suffix (SAP.DE, 7203.T, SHEL.L, 0700.HK), a currency pair (EUR/USD), a future (CL=F, or "crude oil", "gold"), an index (^GSPC, or "S&P 500", "VIX", "10 year yield") or a crypto pair (BTC/USD, or "bitcoin").

name: price_history

outputSchema.description: dates, open, high, low, close and volume are aligned columns, oldest first; change.total_return is the window's return with dividends reinvested (a fraction).

title: Price history
